updateDisplay()

isFull()

requirementMappings.R1: ParkingLot has a list of spots.

flows.name: Park
flows.steps: Call park, it finds a free spot, sets it to not free and saves the time.

decisions.decision: Use one main class for simplicity.

changeImpact.approach: Add an isElectric flag to Car and a hasCharger flag to Spot, and add an if statement in calculateFee to add the per kWh charge.
